topic: Your bones are secretly liquid metal factories
narration: Your bones seem completely dead. Solid, lifeless scaffolding that just holds your body upright against gravity. But inside those hard walls, your bones are quietly running factories that pump liquid metal into your blood. Inside the spongy core, stem cells build hemoglobin around single iron atoms, releasing millions of red blood cells every second. Each cell carries nearly a billion iron atoms, and the iron inside your body could forge one small nail. The hardest part of you makes the metal in your blood.
